description: The line plot illustrates the Micro F1 (%) performance of four different methods—TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval—across varying numbers of samples generated, labeled on the x-axis as K=8, K=16, K=32, and K=64. The y-axis represents the Micro F1 (%) score, ranging from 20 to 55. The TACRED method (blue line with circle markers) shows a steady increase from approximately 23% at K=8 to about 29% at K=64. The TACRED-Revisit method (orange line with triangle markers) starts at around 23% at K=8, rises to about 31% at K=32, and then slightly declines to 30% at K=64. The Re-TACRED method (green line with diamond markers) exhibits a significant increase from roughly 35% at K=8 to a peak of about 51% at K=32, followed by a decrease to approximately 48% at K=64. The SemEval method (red line with square markers) shows a consistent upward trend, starting at around 42% at K=8 and rising to about 52% at K=64. Overall, Re-TACRED achieves the highest performance at K=32, while TACRED consistently has the lowest performance across all sample sizes.
